replies.author: D00ZiE
replies.body:
-1.

I just don't think it looks like a good CTW map. The terrain is way to irregular for the map to play well or have any decent PvP. Also, there aren't supposed to be diamonds on a CTW map, as far as I'm aware. There is hardly any space to actually build a defense too. It looks more like a DTM map than a CTW map.

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body: I think you're right about the terrain, there are some areas that would do great but for the most part its too steep and odd shaped. I think I was too bent on making it look better. I'm not sure about the diamonds but you may be right. Thanks for the feedback. I'm proud of the map for its aesthetics, but I might try to make the terrain better and add more room..

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body: Although I will say that my original intent for the gameplay with that intense terrain was to provoke people to attack stealthily (by building sky bridges or tunneling through). If PvP became necessary it would happen at only certain points: the middle for a bit, then the smaller island, the airship even, and the tunnels. Defense could be built up, but it would take a while so that people would have to start quicker. Usually people only start defending when they have one monument left, this would supply a new fresh gameplay. I think it would work, it's just new and would take getting used to.
